name: Sautéed Kale "Caesar" Penne with Almonds, Bread Crumbs & Parmesan
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ½-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Roughly chop almonds. Add to the bowl with the garlic.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-low heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, and zest lemon into the bowl with the garlic and almonds. (Reserve lemon for later use.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, almonds, lemon zest, bread crumbs, and spices. Cook, stirring often, until golden and toasted, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and return to the bowl. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash, dry, and fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Mince anchovy fillets. Peel and mince additional garlic.

Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add anchovies, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until garlic is fragrant and golden, about 2 minutes.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 1-2 minutes more.

Juice reserved lemon into the skillet. Add pasta, reserved pasta water, and Parmesan. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly and Parmesan has melted, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with the bread crumb mixture. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
